main.description: Grant a role to an account. Requires the admin role. Idempotent: granting a role an account already holds returns the existing grant.

subject.description: The account to grant to, as a DID or a handle. Handles are resolved to DIDs before the grant is written.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.description: The caller is not an admin.

errors.name: InvalidSubject
errors.description: The subject is neither a valid DID nor a resolvable handle.

errors.name: InvalidRole
errors.description: The role is not one this node knows about.
